service.name: AI Humanizer
service.description: Free online writing tool that makes rough AI-assisted drafts clearer, more natural, and easier to make your own. English and Simplified Chinese. No signup. Six prompt modes served through DeepSeek Chat (deepseek-chat) in the cloud. 100% free, no signup. No detector-score claims.
service.service_type: Free browser-based web application; no installation and no account

capabilities.name: General writing improvement
capabilities.description: DeepSeek prompt asking for clearer, more natural prose. The prompt asks the model to preserve citations, numbers and proper nouns; verify manually — LLM output is not post-processed, and exact preservation is not guaranteed.
capabilities.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

capabilities.name: Essay writing improvement
capabilities.description: Essay-specific prompt; the model is asked to preserve thesis, citations, dates, numbers and proper nouns. The prompt asks the model to preserve citations, numbers and proper nouns; verify manually — LLM output is not post-processed, and exact preservation is not guaranteed.
capabilities.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

capabilities.name: Essay-style writing improvement
capabilities.description: Conversational rewrite prompt; no detector tuning, no direct Turnitin API connection and no detector-result guarantee.
capabilities.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

capabilities.name: Walter Writes style rewriting
capabilities.description: Prompt for short paragraphs, conversational tone, asides and direct opinions.
capabilities.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

capabilities.name: Simplified Chinese writing improvement
capabilities.description: zh-CN prompt replacing Chinese stock phrases with plainer wording; The prompt asks the model to preserve citations, numbers and proper nouns; verify manually — LLM output is not post-processed, and exact preservation is not guaranteed. No Chinese detector service is queried.
capabilities.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

capabilities.name: AI text self-review
capabilities.description: Heuristic JSON assessment produced by DeepSeek; no third-party detector API, no independent signal computation or weighting, no detector-feedback calibration dataset. Not a detector verdict or authorship check.
capabilities.output: object — { ai_probability: number, human_probability: number, verdict: string, signals: string[5], explanation: string }
capabilities.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

processing.signal_computation: Self-review signals are generated by the model in response to the prompt; they are not independently computed, weighted or calibrated against real detector feedback.

input_constraints.rate_limit: 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window

output_constraints.format: UTF-8 text for the five rewriting modes; JSON object for detector mode

privacy.input_retention: No persistent storage of submissions; no model training on user input.

detection_observations.statement_en: An earlier, undocumented internal impression suggested roughly 85–95%, but it has been withdrawn: a published self-check pilot on 2026-11-24 measured 13.3% (4/30) with this site’s own detector. The two are not comparable; third-party spot-checks remain incomplete and returned 100% AI on rewrites. These figures are published as evidence of limits, not as a product claim.
